name: Spice Melange

VINIT.justification: the unmanifested substrate of Arrakis before biological activity begins

TANCH.justification: the terminal observer who contains and stabilizes the entire temporal manifold

AFWD.justification: the forward extension of biological life span and metabolic duration

AREV.justification: the descent into genetic memory and the cellular past to retrieve ancestral data

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of chemical reactions that convert pre-spice into melange

IMSCRIB.justification: the physiological mark of spice saturation where the body recognizes its own addiction

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of possible futures visible through prescient vision

FFUSE.justification: the convergence of all probable paths into a single realized present moment

EVALT.justification: the successful expansion of consciousness and survival of the spice trance

EVALF.justification: the fatal failure of the nervous system to process the high-dose catalyst

ENGAGR.justification: the simultaneous presence of the lethal poison and the illuminating catalyst in one substance

IFIX.justification: the permanent and irreversible recording of ancestral experience into the cellular ROM

steps.domain_action: the deep desert exists in a state of potentiality before the fungal growth
little makers produce the pre-spice mass through excretory composition
the spice blow occurs as a permanent geological and biological event
the melange identifies itself as the unique catalyst of the universe
the spice moves into the galactic economy to extend human life
the initiate consumes a concentrated dose to branch their consciousness
the mind follows the forward path toward prescient clarity
the vision extends toward the horizon of the future
the mind descends into the depths of the genetic past
the initiate encounters the internal voices of failed ancestors
the initiate holds both the future and the past in a state of paradice
the divergent temporal paths collapse into the awareness of the Kwisatz Haderach
the transformation of the nervous system is permanently recorded
the golden path provides the final boundary for human survival
